info.title: Atlassian OpsGenie
info.description:
Atlassian OpsGenie is an alert and on-call management platform that enables teams to route, acknowledge, and manage alerts from monitoring and observability tools.

Authentication: API key in Authorization header (GenieKey format) — generate from OpsGenie Settings → API key management. Pass as Authorization: GenieKey <api_key>.

Source: https://docs.opsgenie.com/docs/api-overview
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 108 of 170 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: alerts (create/read/update/close/acknowledge/escalate/assign/snooze/notes/tags/details), incidents, escalations, on-call schedules (rotations/overrides/on-calls), teams (members/routing-rules), maintenance windows, alert/notification policies, integrations, heartbeats, forwarding rules, and users. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
